title: The rainforest path
paragraphs: Every year, students from our school spend a week at a field centre in the rainforest. On {{1}} first morning, our guide warned us to stay on the marked path. Some of the plants could cause a painful rash, and it was easy to get {{2}}.

Dewi wanted a closer photograph of a bright orange bird, so she stepped off the path. She walked only a short way, but when she turned around, she could not see {{3}} of us. Trees looked the same in {{4}} direction.
She remembered what the guide had said: if you are lost, stay where you are and make noise. {{5}} she was frightened, she sat down on a log and began to blow her whistle.

We heard it after a few minutes and followed the sound. The guide was not angry. He simply asked Dewi to tell the group what she had done right. {{6}} that day, nobody left the path, and everyone kept a whistle {{7}} their neck. Dewi still has the photograph, which she says was not worth the fright she {{8}} that morning.
